title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning People's Courts' Decisions on Temporary Service of Sentence Outside Prison

articles.content_en:
The Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:
After the issuance of our Court's 'Interpretation on Several Issues concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China', some Higher People's Courts reported that the circumstances under which the People's Court may decide on temporary service of sentence outside prison as provided in Article 353 of that Interpretation are not clear. Pursuant to the provisions of Article 103 of the 'Decision of the National People's Congress on Amending the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China', the reply is as follows:
According to the provisions of Article 214 of the Criminal Procedure Law, for a criminal sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment or criminal detention, where any of the following circumstances exists, the People's Court may decide on temporary service of sentence outside prison:
(1) Having a serious disease requiring medical treatment outside prison;
(2) Being a pregnant woman or a woman nursing her own infant;
(3) Being unable to take care of oneself, and applying temporary service of sentence outside prison would not harm society.
This is our reply.
